# Third-party source

See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for license scope, source delivery and macFUSE distribution boundaries.

The pinned original NTFS-3G archive is retained for offline corresponding-source access. The build validates its SHA-256 and applies `../Packaging/ntfs-fd-device.patch` before compilation. macFUSE must be independently installed from its official source; its installer is not in this repository or Beta assets.
